description: Stop recording and return the flow as Maestro YAML. save_to writes it to a file in the project (e.g. e2e/flows/TC-12a.yaml) or the temp directory; the reply names the path and the step count. Steps Maestro cannot express are kept as comments in the file.

save_to.description: Where to write the YAML: a path in the project (relative to it, or absolute) or in the temp directory.

name: record_stop
title: Stop recording a flow
